# Balancebot perfboard continuity checklist

<!-- Generated by tools/kicad (python3 -m kicad.perfboard) from hardware.toml; do not edit. -->

Board unpowered, modules out of their sockets, meter on continuity. Pads are named as in `perfboard.md`, from the component side.
After each step of the wire list, hold one probe on the net's first pad and touch every pad after it: each must beep.

| ☐ | PACK_IN | F1.1 (H19) | J1.1 (H24) |
| ☐ | PACK_FUSED | F1.2 (H20) | Q1.2 (F19) |
| ☐ | PFET_GATE | D2.2 (F15) | Q1.1 (F18), R4.1 (J20) |

## Before first power-up

Each pair must **not** beep. Then read it on the resistance range: a reading that starts low and climbs is a capacitor charging, kilohms is a resistor between the rails, and one that stays near 0 Ω is a short. Fit the modules only when every pair passes.

| ✓ | Rail | Rail | Probe on | And on |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ☐ | VBAT | XIAO_5V | A1.8 (B17) | D1.1 (K23) |
| ☐ | VBAT | +3V3 | A1.8 (B17) | A1.10 (G16) |
| ☐ | VBAT | GND | A1.8 (B17) | A1.1 (B10) |
| ☐ | XIAO_5V | +3V3 | D1.1 (K23) | A1.10 (G16) |
| ☐ | XIAO_5V | GND | D1.1 (K23) | A1.1 (B10) |
| ☐ | +3V3 | GND | A1.10 (G16) | A1.1 (B10) |
